notes.title: Crown of Kings Compendium - An Official Wiki is now Live!
notes.content: [h1][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44822485/52042079108958ad65ca1c59493bdacde5ebf14d.png"][/img]Crown of Kings Compendium[/h1][h2]An Official Wiki[/h2][h3]Now Live![/h3][p]We’re excited to announce the launch of the [b]Crown of Kings Compendium[/b], the official Wiki for [b][i]Crown of Kings[/i][/b]. This new online resource is developer-curated and designed to provide accurate, up-to-date information to support your adventures.[/p][h3]What You’ll Find[/h3][list][*][p]Enemies and their stats and abilities[/p][/*][*][p]Quests and Dungeons (and the enemies within)[/p][/*][*][p]Items and where to find them[/p][/*][*][p]Imbue items and recipes to enhance your gear[/p][/*][/list][h3]Why an Official Wiki?[/h3][p]Instead of scattered notes across forums or fan pages, everything is collected in one place. The information is accurate, organized, and synced directly with the actual stats used in the game. Think of it as your adventurer’s handbook to the world of Crown of Kings.[/p][p][/p][p]The Wiki is available here:[/p][p][url="https://www.almighty-games.com/crown-of-kings/wiki/"]https://www.almighty-games.com/crown-of-kings/wiki/[/url][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Demo Update v0.28 – Act I is complete with Boss Battle Arena and Lots of Polish!
notes.content:
[h1]Crown of Kings – Demo Update v0.28[/h1][p][i]Polishing Act I & Facing the Lich King[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44822485/d482c07ed104bf75b5761c457bfdc7a50316d976.png"][/img][/p][p]This update brings Act I of [b]Crown of Kings[/b] closer to completion. The focus has been on polishing, world detail, and finishing the long-awaited [b]Lich King boss battle[/b] — the true climax of the first act. Alongside new battle arena, functional systems, and visual/audio polish, this is one of the most substantial updates yet.[/p][h2][b]The Lich King Battle – Act I Finale[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]True Boss Arena:[/b] The Lich King is no longer just an intro cutscene — he’s a fully-fledged Act I boss.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Quest Giver:[/b] Appears after completing all 4 Act I quests, sending you to the mountaintop ritual site.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Protective Sphere Mechanic:[/b] Lich King cannot be damaged directly — destroy 5 magical devices (Fire, Cold, Poison, Acid, Earth) using imbued weapons to weaken him.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Summoning Chaos:[/b] The Lich King raises waves of skeletons, zombies, mummies, deadguard, wights, slime fiends, and more. Force Field and Mass Death scrolls become invaluable here.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Final Clash:[/b] Once the devices fall, the Lich King’s shield shatters — it’s you vs. the King. Defeat him, and all his minions die with him.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Arena Features[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Acid pit hazard that punishes leaving the battle area.[/p][/*][*][p]Repurposed ritual circle from the game’s intro (the well is still there, now with secret functionality).[/p][/*][*][p]Panoramic view overlooking the village below.[/p][/*][*][p]Hidden treasure chests and easter eggs (including 5 rare imbued scimitars and Mass Death scrolls).[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Post-Battle World Changes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Mountaintop storm dissipates, replaced by peace once the Lich King is slain.[/p][/*][*][p]Reactivating the quest resets storm effects and Lich King’s presence.[/p][/*][*][p]Switching back to earlier quests cancels the Lich King encounter, restoring peace.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Hidden Quests & Quest Items[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Escape Route (Secret Quest):[/b][/p][list][*][p]Triggered by jumping into the ritual well during the boss fight.[/p][/*][*][p]Starts you deep in the dungeon on Floor 3 with objectives (collect skulls, slay mummies).[/p][/*][*][p]Reward: 6,000 silver if completed — but simply finding an exit still gets you home alive.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]The Lich King’s Crown (Quest Item):[/b] Must be looted from the Lich King and returned to the quest giver to complete the quest.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Ship Captain – Act II Tease[/b][/h3][list][*][p]After defeating the Lich King, you’ll be reminded to visit the Ship Captain in town.[/p][/*][*][p]He’s functional as an NPC but travel to Act II is disabled (for now).[/p][/*][*][p]Narrative setup: he offers to take you across the sea, back to your homeland where greater darkness awaits.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Documents & Imbues[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Map Documents:[/b] Fully functional — reveal dungeon maps, chest locations, and hidden keys.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Unique Document Visuals:[/b] Maps, parchments, deeds, blueprints, and scrolls now have unique textures (visible in dungeons, on merchant shelves, and when dropped). No more guessing which is which![/p][/*][*][p][b]Finding Imbue Items:[/b] Imbues scale with dungeon depth:[/p][list][*][p]Floor 1 = 1 imbue item[/p][/*][*][p]Floor 2 = 2 imbue items[/p][/*][*][p]Floor 3 = 3 imbue items … etc.[/p][/*][*][p]Encourages deeper dungeon exploration instead of farming Floor 1 repeatedly.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]Village & NPC Updates[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Gossip Evolution:[/b] Villagers now update their dialogue after each quest, reflecting how your actions change the village.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Flowers & Shrooms Clean-up[/b] ~5,000 props revisited in the village — cleaned up buried/misaligned vegetation for more realism.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Audio & Music Overhaul[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Organic Animal Sounds:[/b] Bees, chickens, pigs, cows, horses, and footsteps now bring the world to life.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Dynamic Dungeon Music:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Intense combat tracks when enemies spot you.[/p][/*][*][p]Eerie exploration tracks when sneaking through halls.[/p][/*][*][p]Unique tracks for character select and the village.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Replaces placeholder acoustic tracks with a polished, reactive music system.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]UI & Feedback Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Transparency Options:[/b] Adjust crosshair, quest/help panels, controller tips, and HUD overlays. Make them opaque, semi-transparent, or invisible.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Potion & Scroll Visuals:[/b] New particle + lighting effects. Potions match their color; scrolls float with their unique symbols visible when cast.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Inventory Feedback:[/b][/p][list][*][p]“Better than Nothing” logic — unequipped slots now always consider new gear an upgrade.[/p][/*][*][p]Throw Equipped Warning — give text feedback when trying to discard equipped gear.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]Polish & Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed invisible projectiles on enemies’ first attack.[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies can no longer shoot through walls or doors.[/p][/*][*][p]Enemy awareness now respects line-of-sight and valid pathfinding.[/p][/*][*][p]Weapon trail now reliably turns off after swings.[/p][/*][*][p]Added reminder text when talking to Gossipers.[/p][/*][*][p]Cleaned up dungeon props so barrels/crates don’t block doorways.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted stack sizes:[/p][list][*][p]Document stacks reduced (20 → 10).[/p][/*][*][p]Town collection task rewards improved (1 item → stack of 5).[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Character Skin Shader Fix:[/b] No more glowing skin in dark dungeons.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Water Shader Fix:[/b] Rivers no longer glow at night — cleaner visuals in village + mountaintop scenes.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]What’s Next[/b][/h3][p]Act I is now feature-complete, polished, and capped with the climactic Lich King battle. The Ship Captain stands ready to take you into Act II — but that adventure is still in development.[/p][p]Stay tuned as we continue expanding [b]Crown of Kings[/b] beyond the village and into the wider world.[/p][p]If you’re enjoying the progress so far:[/p][list][*][p][b]Wishlist Crown of Kings[/b] on Steam[/p][/*][*][p]Share feedback in the community hub[/p][/*][*][p]Tell your friends who love dungeon crawling and dark fantasy![/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks for playing —
[b]— The Almighty Games Team[/b][/p][p][/p]

tags.feature: The Lich King is no longer just an intro cutscene — he’s a fully-fledged Act I boss.
Appears after completing all 4 Act I quests, sending you to the mountaintop ritual site.
Lich King cannot be damaged directly — destroy 5 magical devices (Fire, Cold, Poison, Acid, Earth) using imbued weapons to weaken him.
The Lich King raises waves of skeletons, zombies, mummies, deadguard, wights, slime fiends, and more. Force Field and Mass Death scrolls become invaluable here.
Once the devices fall, the Lich King’s shield shatters — it’s you vs. the King. Defeat him, and all his minions die with him.
Acid pit hazard that punishes leaving the battle area.
Repurposed ritual circle from the game’s intro (the well is still there, now with secret functionality).
Panoramic view overlooking the village below.
Hidden treasure chests and easter eggs (including 5 rare imbued scimitars and Mass Death scrolls).
Mountaintop storm dissipates, replaced by peace once the Lich King is slain.
Reactivating the quest resets storm effects and Lich King’s presence.
Switching back to earlier quests cancels the Lich King encounter, restoring peace.
Triggered by jumping into the ritual well during the boss fight.
Starts you deep in the dungeon on Floor 3 with objectives (collect skulls, slay mummies).
Reward: 6,000 silver if completed — but simply finding an exit still gets you home alive.
Must be looted from the Lich King and returned to the quest giver to complete the quest.
After defeating the Lich King, you’ll be reminded to visit the Ship Captain in town.
He’s functional as an NPC but travel to Act II is disabled (for now).
Narrative setup: he offers to take you across the sea, back to your homeland where greater darkness awaits.
Fully functional — reveal dungeon maps, chest locations, and hidden keys.
Maps, parchments, deeds, blueprints, and scrolls now have unique textures (visible in dungeons, on merchant shelves, and when dropped). No more guessing which is which!
Encourages deeper dungeon exploration instead of farming Floor 1 repeatedly.
Villagers now update their dialogue after each quest, reflecting how your actions change the village.
~5,000 props revisited in the village — cleaned up buried/misaligned vegetation for more realism.
Bees, chickens, pigs, cows, horses, and footsteps now bring the world to life.
Intense combat tracks when enemies spot you.
Eerie exploration tracks when sneaking through halls.
Unique tracks for character select and the village.
Replaces placeholder acoustic tracks with a polished, reactive music system.
Adjust transparency Options: Adjust crosshair, quest/help panels, controller tips, and HUD overlays. Make them opaque, semi-transparent, or invisible.
Potions & Scroll Visuals: New particle + lighting effects. Potions match their color; scrolls float with their unique symbols visible when cast.
“Better than Nothing” logic — unequipped slots now always consider new gear an upgrade.
Throw Equipped Warning — give text feedback when trying to discard equipped gear.

tags.bug: Fixed invisible projectiles on enemies’ first attack.
Enemies can no longer shoot through walls or doors.
Enemy awareness now respects line-of-sight and valid pathfinding.
Weapon trail now reliably turns off after swings.
Added reminder text when talking to Gossipers.
Cleaned up dungeon props so barrels/crates don’t block doorways.
Character Skin Shader Fix: No more glowing skin in dark dungeons.
Water Shader Fix: Rivers no longer glow at night — cleaner visuals in village + mountaintop scenes.

tags.balance_change: Town collection task rewards improved (1 item → stack of 5).

notes.title: Demo Update v0.27 – Game Name Change, Sticky Arrows, Targeted Shots & Lots More
notes.content:
[p]Enemy combat behavior has been reworked from the ground up. This update improves targeting, flanking, dodging, fleeing, ranged logic, and much more. Also includes big fixes for combat feel, collision, and clarity of special effects. Oh — and the game is now officially [b]Crown of Kings[/b].[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44822485/d482c07ed104bf75b5761c457bfdc7a50316d976.png"][/img][/p][h3]Smarter Enemy Combat Tactics[/h3][p][b]Enemy Targeting Tactics[/b][/p][list][*][p]Enemies now select positions [i]around[/i] the player rather than charging head-on[/p][/*][*][p]Simulates flanking and group tactics instead of a crowded front-row mosh pit[/p][/*][*][p]Before attacking, enemies close in on a staging position nearby, then advance — this prevents all enemies from bee-lining at once[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Flank Tactics[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed animation stuttering caused by competing strafe/walk blend[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies now pause briefly after reaching flank range, instead of instantly strafing[/p][/*][*][p]Cooldowns added for changing strafe direction after collisions[/p][/*][*][p]Flank range now respects both minimum and maximum distance[/p][/*][*][p]Collision with obstacles will disrupt flanking and trigger cooldown resets[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Dodge Tactics[/b][/p][list][*][p]Enemies now roll in the direction they’re facing (instead of always facing the player)[/p][/*][*][p]Dodging now triggers even when an enemy is mid-action (e.g., attacking, aiming, summoning)[/p][/*][*][p]Chance to dodge increases as enemy HP drops[/p][/*][*][p]Latency fixes for dodge-related scripting[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Flee Tactics[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fleeing enemies now find safe zones far enough away to regenerate health[/p][/*][*][p]If the player pursues too closely, the enemy can be forced out of Flee state[/p][/*][*][p]If regeneration doesn’t kick in within a few seconds, the enemy will seek a new safe zone[/p][/*][*][p]Once healed or timeout expires, enemies return to patrol[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Ranger Tactics[/b][/p][list][*][p]Completely rewritten for improved AI pacing and reduced overhead[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies with ranged weapons now behave more tactically and less chaotically[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Stomp Attack[/b][/p][list][*][p]Increased damage to make Stomp attacks feel threatening[/p][/*][*][p]Still telegraphed with ample time to dodge — but punishing if ignored![/p][/*][/list][p][b]Ranged Attack Overlap Fix[/b][/p][list][*][p]Enemies can no longer shoot while performing other actions (like melee)[/p][/*][*][p]Prevents payloads from spawning with no animation or logic context[/p][/*][/list][p][b]No More Shooting Through Walls[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed issues with both enemies and players firing through doors or walls[/p][/*][*][p]No more free hits through geometry — fight fair or reposition[/p][/*][/list][h3]Improved Visual Feedback & Effects[/h3][p][b]Curse Cloud Tweaks[/b][/p][list][*][p]Player movement speed now returns within 1–2 seconds after exiting AoE[/p][/*][*][p]Previously took much longer to recover — this feels tighter and more readable[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Sticky Arrows & Bolts[/b][/p][list][*][p]Projectiles now stick into wood and enemies[/p][/*][*][p]Destroy themselves after a few seconds[/p][/*][*][p]Enemy hit zones (head, torso, limbs) apply bonus damage[/p][/*][*][p]Feels punchy and rewards precision[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Sticky Payload Cleanup[/b][/p][list][*][p]Effects and particles on embedded projectiles now deactivate properly[/p][/*][*][p]No more floating lights or lingering VFX when stuck arrows expire[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Map Visual FX[/b][/p][list][*][p]The map’s background now moves together with the map — like parchment, not a transparent overlay[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Trap Conduit Glow[/b][/p][list][*][p]Trap conduits now glow faint red when active[/p][/*][*][p]Makes it easier to trace where the trap’s control switch is located[/p][/*][*][p]Toggle glow on/off by flipping the trap switch[/p][/*][/list][h3]Controls & Collision Polish[/h3][p][b]Weapon Collision Interpolation[/b][/p][list][*][p]Weapon hit detection now accurately follows the swing path using fixed interpolation[/p][/*][*][p]Raycasts were previously misaligned — now fixed and verified to be working as intended[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Xbox Controller Fix[/b][/p][list][*][p]Walking slowly with the stick no longer causes foot-slide[/p][/*][*][p]Animations now scale down naturally instead of freezing[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Doorway Bottlenecks (Partial Fix)[/b][/p][list][*][p]Navmesh and crowding logic improved slightly[/p][/*][*][p]Still some pushing/vibrating when >5 enemies compete for a choke point[/p][/*][*][p]Ongoing work — will improve in future builds[/p][/*][/list][h3]World Systems & Dungeon Improvements[/h3][p][b]Lich King Boss Placement[/b][/p][list][*][p]Lich King will [i]no longer[/i] appear in random dungeons (this was not intended in previous builds)[/p][/*][*][p]Now reserved [i]only[/i] for the final arena battle at the end of Act 1[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Summoner Variety[/b][/p][list][*][p]Occultists and Liches now summon multiple mob types[/p][/*][*][p]Instead of just 1 unit type, they now summon from a variety of low-level mobs at random[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Early Dungeon Simplification[/b][/p][list][*][p]Special abilities and advanced tactics are disabled in early dungeons[/p][/*][*][p]This includes the intro dungeon and Act 1’s opening Lich King scene[/p][/*][*][p]Prevents overwhelm and helps new players adjust[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Lockpick Shortage Solved[/b][/p][list][*][p]Mines & Caves now spawn more lockpicks [i](finally!)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Additional spawns added to other dungeons too[/p][/*][*][p]Fewer blocked chests, more satisfying loot runs[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Workbench Rubies[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed issue where only 1 of 3 rubies could be picked up[/p][/*][*][p]Now collects all rubies on the first click[/p][/*][/list][h3]Act 1 Future Plans[/h3][p][b]Act 1 Completion In Progress[/b][/p][list][*][p]Still developing the final arena with the Lich King showdown[/p][/*][*][p]Once complete, players will be able to “leave” Act 1 by talking to a ship captain[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Quest Variety & Village Upgrades[/b][/p][list][*][p]Collection quests are being revised to feel more natural[/p][/*][*][p]Town NPCs will begin offering meaningful clues and evolving dialogue[/p][/*][*][p]Considering a character journal that fills in as you uncover lore and secrets[/p][/*][/list][h3]A New Name for a Bigger Game[/h3][p]The biggest change this update?[/p][p]The name.[/p][p]What began as [i]Go Deep Or Go Home[/i] is now officially:[/p][h2][b]Crown of Kings[/b][/h2][p]A more fitting title for the game’s world, structure, and long-term vision. The change is now fully live across the demo, hub, and Steam store.[/p][h3]Show Some Love[/h3][list][*][p]Wishlist [b]Crown of Kings[/b] if you haven’t already[/p][/*][*][p]Join the community hub and leave your thoughts[/p][/*][*][p]Share with your friends who like tactical dungeon crawling![/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks again for playing —
— The Almighty Games Team[/p]

tags.bug: [*]Fixed animation stuttering caused by competing strafe/walk blend
[*]Latency fixes for dodge-related scripting
[*]Enemies can no longer shoot while performing actions (like melee)
[*]Prevents payloads from spawning with no animation or logic context
[*]Fixed issues with both enemies and players firing through doors or walls
[*]No more free hits through geometry — fight fair or reposition
[*]Player movement speed now returns within 1–2 seconds after exiting AoE
[*]Effects and particles on embedded projectiles now deactivate properly
[*]No more floating lights or lingering VFX when stuck arrows expire
[*]Weapon hit detection now accurately follows the swing path using fixed interpolation
[*]Raycasts were previously misaligned — now fixed and verified to be working as intended
[*]Walking slowly with the stick no longer causes foot-slide
[*]Animations now scale down naturally instead of freezing
[*]Navmesh and crowding logic improved slightly
[*]Lich King will [i]no longer[/i] appear in random dungeons (this was not intended in previous builds)
[*]Special abilities and advanced tactics are disabled in early dungeons
[*]This includes the intro dungeon and Act 1’s opening Lich King scene
[*]Prevents overwhelm and helps new players adjust
[*]Mines & Caves now spawn more lockpicks [i](finally!)[/i]
[*]Additional spawns added to other dungeons too
[*]Fewer blocked chests, more satisfying loot runs
[*]Fixed issue where only 1 of 3 rubies could be picked up
[*]Now collects all rubies on the first click

tags.balance_change: [*]Increased damage to make Stomp attacks feel threatening

notes.title: Demo Update v0.26 – Smarter Combat, Tactical Enemies & Cleaner Gameplay
notes.content:
[h2]Demo Update v0.26 – Smarter Combat, Tactical Enemies & Cleaner Gameplay[/h2][p]The newest update to the [b]Go Deep Or Go Home[/b] demo is live! This version introduces major improvements to combat animations, enemy tactics, loot variety, and dozens of polish and quality-of-life fixes.[/p][h3]Enhanced Combat Animations[/h3][list][*][p]Attack types like Punch, Swing, Stab, Slash, Overhead, and Thrust now feature multiple animation variations, including alternating left and right-handed motions.[/p][/*][*][p]Adds variety and natural motion during combat[/p][/*][*][p]Less repetitive and more satisfying![/p][/*][/list][h3]New Weapon: The Dagger[/h3][list][*][p]Can now be picked up from environmental decorations (e.g., tabletop daggers)[/p][/*][*][p]Added to the inventory system like any other weapon[/p][/*][*][p]Occasionally equipped by weaker enemies as their melee weapon[/p][/*][*][p]Uses a unique reversed-hand stab animation when equipped[/p][/*][*][p]No backstabbing or stealth mechanics [i](yet)[/i] — just early-game flavor[/p][/*][*][p]Not particularly strong or fast, but looks cool and feels right[/p][/*][*][p]Added mainly because play-testers kept trying to grab it... now you can![/p][/*][/list][h3]Weapon Collision Fix[/h3][list][*][p]Rebuilt hit detection using interpolated raycasts[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes gaps and improves swing accuracy[/p][/*][*][p]Combat feels tighter and more fair[/p][/*][/list][h3]Enemy Ranger Tactics[/h3][list][*][p]Some enemies now switch to ranged attacks mid-fight[/p][/*][*][p]Smarter AI positioning and pacing[/p][/*][*][p]Balanced spawn chances between 1–20% depending on enemy[/p][/*][*][p]No ranged enemies in early scenes... avoids overwhelming new players[/p][/*][/list][h3]Cutscene Skipping[/h3][list][*][p]Hold [b]E[/b] (PC) or [b]A[/b] (Xbox) to skip[/p][/*][*][p]On-screen prompt shows during hold[/p][/*][/list][h3]FTUE Help Tip Updates[/h3][list][*][p]Stash: Tip disappears on opening [i](no more required item move)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Tent: Tip clears on interaction [i](no forced outfit changes)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Quest tips: Delay now waits for player movement, rather than upon completion of previous quest or task.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Quest Giver Logic Fixed[/h3][list][*][p]Quest givers now guide players to the correct next step[/p][/*][*][p]Previously broken... now fixed[/p][/*][/list][h3]Dungeon Decoration Pass[/h3][list][*][p]Catacomb crate tables now have randomized clutter [i](bones, candles, documents, lockpicks)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Spiderwebs add flavor[/p][/*][*][p]Key spawn locations added[/p][/*][*][p]Sarcophagi decorations now visible and functional again[/p][/*][/list][h3]Bug Fixes & Tweaks[/h3][list][*][p][b]Crossbows and bows[/b] now lose durability when their projectiles deal damage, just like melee weapons[/p][/*][*][p][b]Potions[/b] now work correctly [i](yes, they were broken last build... that’s fixed)[/i][/p][/*][*][p][b]Inventory upgrades[/b] preserve item layout when expanding, avoiding unnecessary re-shuffling[/p][/*][*][p][b]Force Field Scroll[/b] now properly blocks incoming projectiles... finally safe inside the bubble[/p][/*][*][p][b]Enemies[/b] no longer crowd awkwardly close to the player; spacing feels more natural in melee[/p][/*][*][p][b]No more item pickups while dead[/b]! That awkward bug is gone[/p][/*][*][p][b]Moving a potion[/b] during use now cancels the action cleanly, preventing animation errors[/p][/*][*][p][b]Consumed food[/b] is now wiped from the player’s stomach on death [i](no more undead digestion)[/i][/p][/*][*][p][b]Xbox controller input[/b] now registers when using the stick, not just buttons[/p][/*][/list][h2]Coming Soon[/h2][p]The next update focuses on finishing Act 1 and preparing for the [b][i]Lich King[/i][/b] boss encounter.[/p][list][*][p][b]Final Arena Battle[/b]: A hand-crafted showdown with the Lich King and his minions, featuring respawning enemies, destructible spawn sources, and a difficulty curve that rewards players who’ve built up socketed gear, imbues, scrolls, and potions.[/p][/*][*][p][b]NPC Gossip Upgrades[/b]: Dialogue will evolve with player progress. NPCs will drop useful tips... including how to defeat the Lich King [i](for those who actually take the time to talk)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Leave Act 1: [/b][i](When You’re Ready)[/i] Once the Lich King is defeated, a ship captain appears to offer travel to Act 2. You choose when to leave. Immediately or after cleaning up remaining content.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Expanded Collection Tasks[/b]: Existing collection mechanics [i](mushrooms → pumpkins, flowers → potions, parchments → scrolls)[/i] are in. notes.title: Demo Update: Smarter Loot, Dungeon Variety & Progression Tweaks
notes.content:
[h1]Demo Update Now Live – Smarter Loot, Better Dungeons, and a Leaner Loop![/h1]

We've just pushed a big update to the [i]Go Deep Or Go Home[/i] [b]Demo[/b], focusing on gameplay flow, loot systems, dungeon variety, and progression clarity. This is our first major Q2 update!

[h2]Item Pickup Logic Overhaul[/h2]
Players will now automatically pick up certain items under smarter conditions:
[list]
[*] Stackable items (already present in your backpack)
[*] Imbue items, gems, potions, scrolls, and collectibles are now picked up automatically
[*] Everything else must be picked up with the [b]Use Key[/b]
[*] Keeps your inventory organized and intentional
[/list]
This change prevents the backpack from filling up with junk while still reducing friction with common loot.

[h2]Enhanced Dungeon Variety[/h2]
[list]
[*] More decor randomization across [b]Catacombs[/b], [b]Classic Dungeons[/b], and [b]Mines & Caves[/b]
[*] Less predictable room structures and visuals
[/list]
While subtle, these changes make dungeon layouts feel less predictable during repeated runs.

[h2]New Progress Unlock System[/h2]
[list]
[*] Inventory size and item tiers now scale as you complete objectives
[*] Loot and merchant stock improve over time
[*] No more access to everything right from the start
[/list]

[h2]Town Collection Tasks[/h2]
[list]
[*] Collect mushrooms, flowers, and parchments
[*] Turn in for rewards like pumpkins, potions, scrolls
[*] Tasks unlock new dungeons and expand inventory
[/list]

[h2]Socket Limitations by Act[/h2]
To help stretch progression across the full game and give sockets more meaning.
[list]
[*] Act 1: 1 socket  
[*] Act 2: 2 sockets  
[*] Act 3: 3 sockets  
[/list]

[h2]Improved Help Tips (FTUE)[/h2]
The in-game Help Tips system has been expanded and restructured:
[list]
[*] New contextual help prompts for first-time players
[*] Reorganized tips appear at better moments
[*] Helps direct players through the Lich King intro, town systems, and more
[/list]

[h2]Balanced Game Economy[/h2]
[list]
[*] Level gating for item spawns (weapons, armor, imbue items, etc.)
[*] Weapon damage, stack sizes, potion effects all tuned
[*] Only one imbue item per floor, found in locked chests
[/list]

[h2]Full Screen Scrollable Map[/h2]
[list]
[*] Toggle between [i]Hidden[/i], [i]Mini[/i], and [i]Full Screen[/i]
[*] Scroll using movement keys while character is locked
[/list]

[h2]Demo Scope Adjusted (45–60 Minutes)[/h2]
[list]
[*] Focused on [b]Quest 1[/b] and [b]2 early Town Tasks[/b]
[*] Enough to hook new players and let gear progression shine
[*] Replayable, but much tighter
[/list]

[h2]What’s Next[/h2]

The next update will focus entirely on polishing and finalizing all of Act 1. The goal is to make sure everything in the first act feels like a complete and well-rounded game experience before moving forward.

Planned work includes:
[list]
[*] [b]Combat improvements[/b]: New animations for both player and enemies, including dodging, varied attacks, and cleaner transitions. More visual feedback!
[*] [b]Lich King Arena Battle[/b]: After completing Quest 4, players will ascend to the mountain arena to confront the Lich King in a proper boss encounter. You’ll need to bring everything you’ve earned... potions, scrolls, and gear upgrades, if you hope to survive.
[*] [b]Post-Battle Story Reveal[/b]: Defeating the Lich King triggers a cutscene that explains your true identity, connecting the player to the larger world and lore.
[*] [b]Village Reactions[/b]: After the boss fight, town gossip and NPC dialogue will change to reflect the outcome, signaling that Act 1 is complete and the world is evolving.
[*] [b]Leaving the Village[/b]: A small boat and a captain NPC will appear at the docks, offering transport to Act 2 once Act 1 is fully complete.
[*] [b]Ongoing polish[/b]: Expect continuous updates to potions, scrolls, harvesting, character control, enemy behavior, and everything else that can be experienced in Act 1.
[/list]

This phase is all about building a solid, playable foundation. Once Act 1 is fully implemented, the game will be in a strong position for Early Access — whether that’s independently or with the support of a publisher.

[h2]Help Us Spread the Word[/h2]
If you enjoyed the update, help us out:
[list]
[*] Leave feedback in the Community Hub
[*] [b]Wishlist[/b] the full game!
[*] Share with friends who love dungeon crawlers
[/list]

Thanks for playing —  
[i]— The Almighty Games Team[/i]
